privacy.title: Privacy & data
privacy.description: Control who can find you, what they see and how your data is used. Every change takes effect straight away.
privacy.minor.title: Extra protection while you are under 18
privacy.minor.description: Marketing messages, overseas processing and activity tracking stay off until you turn 18. Your parent or guardian can contact Venkat Sai support about your data at any time.
visibility.title: Profile visibility
visibility.description: Choose who can discover your profile in candidate search.
disclosure.title: What employers can see
disclosure.description: These settings apply to every employer and recruitment partner. Your contact details are never shown in search results.
disclosure.fullName.hint: Otherwise employers see only your initials until you apply to their job.
disclosure.currentEmployer: The name of my current employer
disclosure.currentEmployer.hint: Useful to keep your job search private from your current employer.
disclosure.contactUnlockedOnly: Share contact details only after I apply or an employer unlocks my profile
disclosure.contactUnlockedOnly.hint: Recommended. Every time an employer reveals your contact details it is recorded.
disclosure.directContact: Allow employers to message me directly
disclosure.directContact.hint: Messages arrive in the portal. You can turn this off at any time.
disclosure.partnerSubmissions: Allow recruitment partners to put me forward for jobs
disclosure.partnerSubmissions.hint: Partners never see other partners' work or your private documents.
blocked.label: Blocked organisations
blocked.hint: Blocked employers and partners cannot find or view your profile, and lose access to your files straight away.
blocked.typeToSearch: Type at least 2 letters to search.
consent.title: Your consents
consent.description: Give or withdraw each consent separately. Withdrawing does not affect anything done before.
consent.marketing_email: Email about new opportunities and services
consent.marketing_email.hint: Occasional emails from Venkat Sai Global. Account and application emails are always sent.
consent.marketing_sms: SMS about new opportunities and services
consent.marketing_sms.hint: Occasional text messages from Venkat Sai Global.
consent.whatsapp_updates.hint: Application, interview and training updates on WhatsApp, when available.
consent.overseas_processing: Process my details for overseas recruitment
consent.overseas_processing.hint: Lets Venkat Sai and licensed recruiting agents share your profile with overseas employers for jobs you apply to. You never pay to apply.
consent.share_assessment_results: Share my passed Venkat Sai assessments with employers
consent.share_assessment_results.hint: Employers who can see your profile also see the assessments you passed.
consent.contact_references: Allow Venkat Sai to contact my references
consent.contact_references.hint: Only to verify your work experience.
consent.profile_discoverable.hint: Follows your profile visibility setting above.
consent.partner_submission: Recruitment partners may put me forward
consent.partner_submission.hint: Follows the partner setting in “What employers can see”.
consent.share_profile_with_employers: Share my profile with employers I apply to
consent.share_profile_with_employers.hin: Given for each application. Withdraw an application to stop sharing with that employer.
cookies.title: Cookies on this device
cookies.description: Choose which optional cookies this browser may use.
requests.title: Your data rights
requests.description: Download, correct or delete your data. We respond to requests within {days} days and may contact you to confirm your identity.
requests.confirmRequired: Please confirm that you understand what happens next.
requests.export.title: Download my data
requests.export.description: Get a copy of your profile data now as a file.
requests.export.full: For everything we hold, including applications and uploaded files, ask for a full copy.
requests.correction.title: Correct my data
requests.correction.description: Most details can be changed on your profile. Use this for details you cannot change yourself, such as your date of birth.
requests.correction.hint: Say which detail is wrong and what it should be.
requests.deletion.title: Delete my data and close my account
requests.deletion.description: Ask us to delete your personal data. Your account is closed as part of the request.
requests.deletion.effectsTitle: What happens and what we must keep
requests.deletion.effect1: Your profile is removed from search and employers lose access to it and your files.
requests.deletion.effect2: Open applications are withdrawn and saved jobs and alerts are deleted.
requests.deletion.effect3: Once the request is completed your account is closed and you can no longer sign in. This cannot be undone.
requests.deletion.retentionTitle: Records we may have to keep
requests.deletion.retention1: Invoices, payment and tax records, for the period the law requires.
requests.deletion.retention2: Records of overseas recruitment and emigration processing required by law.
requests.deletion.retention3: Records needed for an open complaint, grievance or legal claim.
requests.deletion.details: Anything you would like us to know (optional)
requests.deletion.understood: I understand what will be deleted and what may be kept.
requests.none: You have not made any data requests.
access.title: Who viewed your details
access.description: Organisations that viewed your profile, contact details or documents. Names of individual people are not shown.
access.empty: No one has viewed your details yet
access.emptyDescription: When an employer, partner or the Venkat Sai team views your profile or contact details, it appears here.
grievance.title: Raise a concern
grievance.description: If you are unhappy with how your data is handled, raise a grievance. We acknowledge it within {hours} hours and aim to resolve it within {days} days.
notifications.description: Updates about your applications, interviews, training and account.
notifications.emptyAllDescription: Updates about your applications, interviews and training will appear here.
notifications.error: That did not work. Please try again.
career.description: Build a resume, ask the Venkat Sai team for help and see which skills employers are asking for.
career.resume.title: Resume builder
career.resume.description: Turn your profile into a clean resume and save it as a PDF.
career.resume.builderDescription: Built from your profile. Choose a template, then print or save it as a PDF.
career.resume.note: Both templates use plain text and standard headings, which applicant tracking systems read well.
career.resume.how: Select “Print or save as PDF”, then choose “Save as PDF” as the printer. Your resume is not stored anywhere else.
career.resume.thin: Add your experience, education and skills on your profile to make your resume stronger.
career.resume.privacy: Your resume includes your email and phone number. Share it only with employers you trust. Manage your data in
career.services.title: Ask the Venkat Sai team
career.services.description: Send a request and our team will reply in your support requests with the next steps.
career.service.resume_review.description: Get feedback on your resume from the Venkat Sai team.
career.service.career_counselling.descri: Talk about your goals, training options and next steps.
career.service.interview_preparation.des: Prepare for an interview or trade test.
career.request.resume_review.hint: Tell us the kind of job you are applying for. Upload your resume on your profile first.
career.request.career_counselling.hint: Tell us about your goals and any questions you have.
career.request.interview_preparation.hin: Tell us about the interview or trade test you are preparing for.
career.request.follow: Follow it in your support requests
career.gap.title: Skill gap analysis
career.gap.description: Compares your skills with the skills most often listed on live jobs.
career.gap.noDataScoped: There are no live jobs with listed skills in your preferred categories ({categories}) right now. Check back soon or widen your preferences.
career.gap.noDataAll: There are no live jobs with listed skills right now. Check back soon.
career.gap.coverageText: You have {value}% of the in-demand skills
career.gap.basisAll_one: Based on {count} live job across all categories.
career.gap.basisAll_other: Based on {count} live jobs across all categories.
career.gap.narrow: Choose job categories for a more relevant comparison
career.gap.noneMissing: You already list every in-demand skill we found.
career.gap.noneMatched: None of your listed skills appear on these jobs yet.
career.gap.noCourses: No published course teaches these skills yet.
career.gap.method: How this works: we count how many live jobs list each skill, show the most requested ones, and match them against the skills on your profile. No automated judgement is made about you.
career.prep.title: Interview preparation
career.prep.description: Guides and videos from the Venkat Sai team.
career.prep.soonDescription: Interview preparation guides have not been published yet. Meanwhile, you can ask for interview preparation above.
